EMS-CTRL-006.rationale: Recovery readiness is evidenced at the deployable service/runtime boundary because recovery objectives, procedures, and recovery exercises apply to services.

EMS-CTRL-007.rationale: AI-assisted development governance is an organization-wide engineering policy covering approved AI services, confidential-data protection, and human accountability.

EMS-CTRL-016.rationale: Evidence integrity and retention governs control evidence identification, integrity protection, retrieval, and retention and is therefore an EMS evidence-management control.

EMS-CTRL-055.rationale: Policy Before Execution is implemented by the shared execution/control platform before workloads or agents are allowed to run.

EMS-CTRL-056.rationale: Agent Identity Verification is enforced by the shared identity/execution platform rather than independently by each repository.

EMS-CTRL-057.rationale: Audit Envelope Generation is produced by the shared execution/control plane; EMS consumes and retains the resulting evidence.

EMS-CTRL-058.rationale: Fail-Closed Authorization is a runtime authorization-enforcement responsibility of the shared platform.

EMS-CTRL-059.rationale: Execution Isolation Validation governs sandbox/runtime isolation and belongs at the shared compute/execution platform boundary.

EMS-CTRL-060.rationale: Zero Trust Integration Testing validates integration of shared Zero Trust execution and security capabilities and is a platform-level control.
